confirmation_policy: No holdout, tuning, model choice, or adoption decision; this is a one-time Train-only implementation regression replay over known data.

trials.comparison: pre-fix versus corrected feature builder under identical fixed models

feature_definitions: Existing variable-duration box features; only prior-close True Range share-unit handling changes.
model: Existing bidirectional annual expanding Ridge(lambda=1.0), followed by existing event ranking and EWMA score smoothing(alpha=0.25).
selection_rule: None. Verify the accounting identity, causal/data contracts, finite coverage and deterministic execution. Report descriptive Train metrics without selecting or tuning a candidate.
